_about: Legend ep 01, the masked woman (Kuchisake-onna). Speakers: N narrator (deep storyteller), G grandmother, K kid, W masked woman. Read by VoxCPM2, then tempo x1.15 (Jonny 25 Nov).

G.style: an old woman in her eighties, warm but stern, low slightly raspy voice, slow and calm

K.style: a twelve-year-old boy from a film, natural child actor, clearly a boy, voice not broken yet, curious and quietly worried, speaks clearly with crisp diction

W.style: a young woman, soft, calm, sweet and very quiet, almost a whisper, eerie and slow

lines: Whatever she asks you... never say yes.
In Japan, they call her Kuchisake-onna. She waits under streetlights, in a white mask, and she asks every child the same question.
Then she gets angry. Very angry.
Say yes... and she takes off the mask.
And under it, is a smile that reaches all the way to her ears.
Made up? In 1979, this story spread so fast that schools in Japan sent children home in groups, and police patrolled the streets at night.
Kids back then learned the one answer that confuses her, and the one thing she can't resist.
Then, hard candy. She has to pick up every single piece.
